On modern Android versions, starting from the background is often blocked; you then get a notification to open the app and start yourself. Android can also mute the microphone during calls. Turning it off stops a recording that started automatically.

<b>Gesprek (handsfree).</b> Tik in de as: Conversation (hands-free). Tap the microphone at the top of the assistant (or "Start a conversation"): it listens, notices when you've finished speaking, reads the answer sentence by sentence and then listens again. Say "stop" or "done" to stop. The screen stays on while the conversation runs; it stops on a phone call or when you leave the assistant. A suggestion (timer, message, setting) only happens here too after a tap.
<b>Inspreken.</b> Tik in het gesprek op: Speaking. Tap the microphone in the chat and ask your question out loud. You see that it's listening, and the text appears while you talk. Tap ✓ when you're done: everything is transcribed properly once more and the text goes into the input field, to check or send. ✕ cancels. Everything happens on the phone with the speech model of Transcribe calls (Whisper); the recording is deleted afterwards and nothing goes to the internet.
